Dense Vector Search • Embed query (BGE-base-en-v1.5) • pgvector HNSW Cosine Search
Lexical FTS Search • to_tsquery OR-expansion ('|') • GIN index + ts_rank_cd ranking

Modular RRF Fusion (k=60) • Standard (1:1) or Weighted (70/30)
HTTP 404: No relevant documents found (Bypasses LLM, Prevents Hallucination)
Build Grounded Context Context: [1]... [k] + User Query
